method: Whole rank.c/h read, Git blob verification; no runtime execution.
findings: Candidate grouping requires same observed size and symlink flag, then optional basename, extension, stem, parent basename and relative-path matches. These are explicit search filters and can split byte-identical files.
Case-insensitive comparison is ASCII case folding, not complete Unicode/filesystem name equivalence. Extension extraction is delegated to utilities and remains to inspect.
Original selection prioritizes lint type, regular-vs-symlink and preferred path, followed by configured mtime/name/length/depth/link/path/regex ranking. Ranking does not establish content equality.
Relative-path match compares traversal depth and corresponding trailing components, not root identity; directly supplied depth0 paths compare basenames.
Regex results cached in file bitmasks; compile limits patterns to RM_PATTERN_N_MAX(8). Cache freshness across configuration changes requires session lifecycle review.
Pattern delimiter parser checks only immediately preceding backslash for escaping angle brackets; complete regex escape parity not handled by this parser. No malformed-pattern runtime control yet.
Pattern compilation may return minified criteria alongside error; callers must reject error before using regex indexes. No claim of reachable invalid indexing until caller inspection.
limits: Static source audit, no tests or own-library edits.
Config defaults, argument validation, utilities and session setup remain to inspect. Native pHash deferred; global count150/500.
